parsed.rationale: One of the two participating records lives at `Shared/Wallpaper/Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/Sources/DebugHUD.swift`, which sits under the `Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/` directory — a structural sample-app marker that triggers the sample-app-mirror restraint regardless of the `is_sample_app` flag value. The production copy in `Shared/DebugPanel/Sources/DebugPanel/DebugMetricsProvider.swift` (package `DebugPanel`) is the authoritative implementation; the copy in the Wallpaper sample app is a deliberate, self-contained demonstration fixture. Consolidating the two would couple the `DebugPanel` production package to sample-app semantics, which is the canonical anti-pattern the restraint rule is designed to prevent.
